errors.text: The loading conditions are substantially incorrect: the target uses molecular-dynamics strain rates of 10^8-10^10 s^-1 and orientations <110>, <1-12>, and <-111>, whereas the hypothesis substitutes experimental rates of 10^-4-10^2 s^-1 and different orientations.
The orientation trend is reversed or otherwise misidentified: the target finds maximum yield stress along <-111>, not <001>.

The proposed TWIP and cryogenic martensitic HCP transformation contradict the target result of Shockley-partial-mediated stacking faults with local HCP-like classification but no twinning or bulk phase transformation.
The hypothesis assigns nucleation to surfaces or generic pre-existing sources, while the periodic bulk target specifically identifies vacancy clusters/disordered atoms as nucleation sites.
Lomer-Cottrell unlocking, CSRO-controlled rate insensitivity, and surface-defect nucleation are not established by the cited evidence.
The supporting studies concern Co-containing bulk material or CoNiCrFeMn nanowires rather than the bulk periodic single-crystal FeNiCrMn system, limiting their evidentiary relevance.
